title: zerna rubens
intro: Zerna rubens, commonly known as Red Clover, is a perennial flowering plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and the Middle East. The plant is known for its health benefits, including reducing symptoms of menopause and alleviating hot flashes due to its estrogenic properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover include isoflavones, specifically genistein and daidzein, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
